You can now create your Nostr seed phrase from real dice instead of your computer's randomness.

Nostr WoT 0.8.15 adds a dice and coin game to account setup. 100 dice rolls or 256 coin flips give the 256 bits behind a 24-word BIP-39 phrase. The game opens in its own tab, so a long session is not lost when the popup closes.

The words never appear in that tab.

Coin flips are the entropy bits, first flip first. Dice rolls are written as digits and hashed with SHA-256, the same method Coldcard uses, so the same throws always give the same 24 words and you can check them offline. We did not mix in machine randomness, because that would make the phrase impossible to verify by hand.

The phrase is only as random as the throws you record. Numbers you make up are far less random than they feel.

Version 0.8.15 is available on GitHub. Browser-store publication is separate.
